title: Confidential Commission
text:
For the bearer alone

Your existing appointment as a confidential field officer remains in force. Maintain your civilian identity and report by the agreed channel. The enclosed one hundred septims are an initial allowance, not an advance against a claim.

Do not present yourself as a uniformed member of my delegation, promise favors in my name, or treat personal acquaintance as operational authority. Further instructions await at the secure box. Audiences are by summons.

Elenwen
First Emissary

title: Accounts: Advance Receipt
text:
Five hundred septims issued as an operational advance, against the hire of a sword. Recognised costs settle this sum before any reimbursement. Return the unused balance within fourteen days.

Personal spending from the advance remains payable by the bearer.

Accounts

title: Accounts: Funds Returned
text:
Funds were received against the bearer's outstanding advance and liability. The current balance is shown on the statement.

This receipt does not authorise another advance.

Accounts

title: Accounts: Overdue Advance
text:
The fourteen-day period for the advance has expired. Unreturned funds are now the bearer's liability, and further advances are suspended while money remains due.

Return the funds through the case. A valid later claim may discharge recognised costs against this balance.

Accounts

title: Claim: Hire Fee, Five Hundred Septims
text:
Declared cost: five hundred septims. Purpose: the hire of a sword, as instructed. Payee: declared by the bearer.

Submitted for review. A declaration is not proof of payment.

C.

title: Claim: Hire Fee and Expenses, Six Hundred and Fifty Septims
text:
Declared cost: six hundred and fifty septims. Purpose: the hire of a sword, with expenses on the road. Payee: declared by the bearer.

This exceeds the authorised fee and requires review.

C.

title: Claim: A Gift
text:
Declared cost: sixty septims. Purpose: a gift to the hired sword.

No instruction required it. Its inclusion is disclosed.

C.

title: Claim: A Meal
text:
Declared cost: forty septims. Purpose: a meal on the road.

Its connection to the instruction has not been explained.

C.

title: Accounts Decision: Allowed
text:
The declared fee is allowed. Recognised costs first settle the advance or any liability; any balance due to the bearer is paid on collection.

Accounts

title: Accounts Decision: Partly Allowed
text:
Of the six hundred and fifty septims declared, five hundred are allowed: the fee. The remainder is personal expenditure, and any part of it drawn from the advance is owed.

Accounts

An advance is permission to spend what was agreed. — E.

title: Accounts Decision: Not Allowed
text:
Personal expenditure is not chargeable. Any portion drawn from the advance is owed by the bearer.

Accounts

Your generosity is your own affair, and so is its cost. — E.

title: Accounts Decision: Explanation Required
text:
The meal is returned without settlement. State whether it was necessary to the hire or a personal expense, and file the explanation through the case. Nothing is paid by this notice.

The fourteen-day obligation on the advance is not suspended.

Accounts

title: Explanation: Necessary Meal
text:
The meal was a necessary meeting with the hired sword, not entertainment. Forty septims are claimed; no more than twenty are allowable.

C.

title: Explanation: Personal Meal
text:
The forty-septim meal was a personal expense. No instruction required it.

C.

title: Accounts Decision: Meal Allowance
text:
Twenty septims of the meal are allowed; the remainder is personal. Recognised costs first settle any advance or liability.

Accounts

A meeting may justify a modest meal. It does not justify the bill you sent. — E.
